Attending full-day secondary school classes, taking notes and completing set work

Sorting and running a load of washing, then hanging items to dry (Member 1 and Member 2 are out walking the dog)

Reading a book and listening to calm music to wind down and ease anxiety

Lying in bed with the light off and the fan running, trying to fall asleep
